description: This Java class defines a 'Device' object representing an authenticated client device in the Hono framework. It handles device identity, authorities, and provides methods for authorization checks and retrieving device and tenant IDs.

classes.name: Device
classes.description: Represents an authenticated device with identity and authorities, based on a JSON Web Token.

methods.name: Device
methods.description: Constructor that creates a Device instance from a JWT token, extracting tenant, device ID, and authorities.

methods.name: Device
methods.description: Constructor that creates a device with explicit tenant and device ID.

methods.name: getPrincipal
methods.description: Creates a JSON object representing the device's principal with tenant and device IDs.

methods.name: checkAuthorization
methods.description: Checks if the device has a specific authority.

methods.name: principal
methods.description: Returns the JSON representation of the device's principal.

methods.name: getTenantId
methods.description: Returns the tenant ID associated with the device.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the device ID, implementing Principal interface.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the device.

methods.name: asAddress
methods.description: Constructs an address string from tenant and device IDs or from a Device object.
